problem_statement: V3 injected the frozen direction at layer 2 and measured its layer-3 residual-stream projection, while the target condition measured immediately after layer-3 injection. Ordinary adjacent-layer residual transport can therefore contribute to the wrong-layer effect; the V3 failure remains controlling and cannot distinguish transport from localization.

hypotheses.layer_specificity: On a common held-out final-layer linear readout frozen from calibration baselines, the layer-3 intervention has the unique largest signed median effect at both +/-0.5 and every off-target layer has no more than 0.5 of the target-layer median absolute effect, including the fixed-bootstrap 95 percent upper bound.
hypotheses.adjacent_transport_diagnostic: If layer-2 target-direction influence is carried mainly through the target-direction component present after layer 3, prospectively removing only that propagated component at layer 3 reduces the common-readout effect by at least 80 percent at both signs.
hypotheses.important_boundary: Adjacent transport support is explanatory only. It cannot overturn V3, satisfy layer specificity, or authorize a steering claim.

common_readout.capture: final transformer layer prompt-final non-padding hidden state before LM head
common_readout.construction: unit-L2 difference between the mean baseline final-layer hidden state for 8 sealed calibration ^0|C prompts and the mean for 8 sealed calibration ^0|E prompts; sign fixed toward ^0|C; no held-out use

heldout_validity_floor.metric: balanced accuracy from sign of baseline readout margin on the 32 sealed target/contrast held-out prompts

layer_comparison.direction: unchanged frozen V2 sparse unit-L2 ^0|C direction
layer_comparison.common_endpoint: change from the same-prompt baseline in the frozen final-layer readout margin

patchback_controls.layer2_projection_patchback: After layer-2 intervention, at layer 3 subtract only the change from the same-prompt baseline along the frozen intervention direction; retain orthogonal differences; then measure the common final-layer readout and downstream logits.
patchback_controls.layer2_full_state_patchback: After layer-2 intervention, restore the full prompt-final layer-3 hidden state from the same-prompt baseline; downstream logits must restore within 1e-5 max absolute residual.
patchback_controls.target_layer_full_state_patchback: After target-layer intervention, restore the full prompt-final layer-3 hidden state from the same-prompt baseline; downstream logits must restore within 1e-5 max absolute residual.
